examples (Freedom, FreeSpan Gantry, Golvo, Likorall) are named mobile/gantry patient hoists
examples (Devon, Dyna-Form Mercury, Moray Combo Deluxe, Pure Air) are pressure-care mattress product lines
examples (Bure Rise & Go, Lotus, Lotus XL, MiniLift) are mobile standing/transfer hoists, which the handling:hoist type explicitly covers as 'Hoists and standing aids'
examples (EasySlide, emotion In-bed System, MySlide Slide Sheets, Superfine In-bed System) are slide-sheet/in-bed repositioning systems
examples (D30 Uno Maxi, Tri-Chair, Uno Midi, Uno Mini) are specialist seating product lines
division name is Adult Beds; examples (Allura, Dali Eco, Dali Economic, Regia) are bed model names
